mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS topicId, t.title, t.subtitle, t.cover_img AS coverImg, t.follow_count AS followCount, t.question_count AS questionCount, f.created_at AS followedAt FROM qa_topic_follow f JOIN qa_topic t ON t.id = f.topic_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND t.status = 1 ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.id DESC
